title: Merge local settings and save default configuration
goal: uses object expansion to create a shallow copy, and then overwrites the fields in order.
summary: page has a default setting, and each workspace can define only the fields to be covered. The default settings also need to continue to serve other workspaces.
tasks: completes mergeSettings(defaults, overrides) and creates a new object containing both their own fields.
fields have the same name, overrides take precedence and defaults are not changed. Both the boolean false and the number 0 can be overridden.

example.code:
const defaults = { mode: 'list', dense: false };
const merged = { ...defaults, dense: true };
example.note: will overwrite the previous value. Expand only copies outer fields.

hint: Expand defaults first, then expand overrides.
